description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for data access operations related to the Buzz feature. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and updating buzz posts, comments, shares, photos, and links, as well as for managing related counts and filtering. The class interacts with various entity classes such as BuzzPost, BuzzShare, BuzzComment, and others, using Doctrine ORM QueryBuilder for database operations.

classes.name: BuzzDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Buzz-related entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, counts, and filtered retrieval of posts, comments, shares, photos, and links within the Buzz module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Fetches an array of BuzzFeedPost objects based on filter parameters, including related links, likes, shares, and posts.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Buzz feed posts matching given filter criteria.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves all photo IDs associated with a specific post.

methods.name: saveBuzzPost
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPost entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLink entity representing a video.

methods.name: saveBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPhoto entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzComment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Removes a specified BuzzComment from the database.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoById
methods.description: Fetches a BuzzPhoto by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzShareById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare by its ID, including related entities.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzComment by its ID, optionally filtered by share ID.

methods.name: getBuzzComments
methods.description: Returns an array of BuzzComment objects matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of BuzzComments matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsPaginator
methods.description: Internal method to get a paginated collection of comments for a share.

methods.name: isEmployeeLikedOnComment
methods.description: Checks if an employee has liked a specific comment.

methods.name: getBuzzPostById
methods.description: Fetches a BuzzPost by its ID, including related entities.

methods.name: getBuzzPostTypeByPostId
methods.description: Determines the type of a post (photo, video, or text) based on its content.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPostPhotos
methods.description: Deletes specified photos associated with a post.

methods.name: getBuzzLinkByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLink associated with a post, if any.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPost
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzPost by ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzShare by ID.

methods.name: adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Updates the counts of likes and comments on shares based on current data.

methods.name: adjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Updates the like count on comments based on current data.

methods.name: getBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare that is associated with a specific post.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of shares for a specific post based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesCount
methods.description: Gets the count of shares for a post based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Internal method to build a query for fetching post shares based on filters.
